reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and this is bisglycinate with no oxide, a named independent lab and a report per batch. That is exactly what I check before buying, and $24.99 with a money-back guarantee is low risk to try one box.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I will open the lab report first, and if it is vague or the lab is not a real one, I am out. I also want to know it is the same report for my batch, not a generic one.
would_change_my_mind: A lab report that is missing, unreadable, or from an unnamed lab on the product page would flip me to no.
